newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate down 90 bps to 10.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate down 90 bps to 10.9 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate dipped 90 basis points to 10.9 percent on Thursday in balanced trade dominated by favourable call money deals.
Two thirds of 31 million total settlements were fresh borrowings, mostly struck at an unchanged call money rate of 10.5 percent.
Insurers renewed one-week funds at a steady nine percent while rates for bankers' two- and three-week loans ranged between 14 and 16 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Friday firmer at 6.0146 versus the dollar and slightly weaker at 3.5657 against the German mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
